steps.name: The Path to Answers (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Narsha] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」, then turn in the quest to [Raclette].

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, have you been well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Surely nothing's happened to Narsha…?)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I've been… all right….
(There is something sad behind her forced smile. As if trying to dispel that feeling, the magic golem Madori fidgets on Narsha's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Madori, you're such a good friend…. Just like Anise and Ambrosia.
(As if sensing Narsha's feelings, Madori stops moving.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I lied. I haven't been all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: A suspicious man from the Magic Bureau came and said he was taking Madori back. I refused and asked who had ordered it, but he couldn't answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But the Magic Bureau told you to be Madori's owner.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, that's right. He tried to take Madori by force, so I screamed. Luckily, Jelic and Raclette came over and chased him away.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: At first, I thought he was just using the Magic Bureau as an excuse because he was fascinated by Madori. But that wasn't it. He's already come three times, pretending to be someone else, and tried to take Madori….

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Einst, Jelic, Raclette, and the President all said they'd catch him if they saw him, but he always disappears right away….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could it be the witch…?)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I was frightened. He looked like a different person at first, but when he reached out, he was the same man. That man….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A man?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, a man…. He was carrying a large staff, so I thought he was a mage, but he seemed more like a shaman….

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: So I've been scared lately. I can't go anywhere. I just stay here. It feels as though he's after me, not Madori….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something else, isn't there?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes….

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: He had ears like mine. His arms weren't like mine, though…. And he didn't have a tail, so I couldn't quite call him beastfolk….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this was it….

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: What? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: If you know something, could you please tell me? Is he a member of the Kali tribe? Like those people you know…?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I haven't seen him myself, so it's hard to say.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I know it's a lot to ask, but could you take me to see them?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Ah….

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm sorry…. I was only thinking of myself….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I'm sorry. I'm sorry I couldn't comfort you. Oh, that reminds me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Spirit King I met asked me to tell the next person I met that they would have the spirits' blessing.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thank you. The spirits' blessing…. Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm not sure why, but I suddenly feel better. It's like drinking a glass of ice-cold water.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is it just my imagination? Narsha looks happier….)

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Hi, Narsha. Hello, %s. I've been looking for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jelic, it's been a while. You were looking for me?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Would you like some cake first? I made lots for Narsha. Raclette told me not to make too much, but I couldn't help it.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Mmm, the cakes and cookies are delicious, but I've been eating so many lately….
(Jelic looks crestfallen at Narsha's words.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Still, I'll have some. You made it for me, after all, and I was just getting hungry….

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: You can look forward to dinner too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What flavor is this one? It tastes a little different…. Oh, that's not what matters right now. Why were you looking for me?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: I'd like to speak with you over there for a moment. Narsha, may I borrow the adventurer?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, of course. And Adventurer, I feel better now that you've listened to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: That's good. In that case, I'll leave you some of Jelic's handmade Madori jellies too.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Now, Adventurer. Let's go see Raclette.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hmm….

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Madori, you feel full of energy too, don't you? How strange. Why is that?

steps.name: The Path to Answers (2)
steps.objective: Explore 「Western El Anoir Plains」 and talk to the unexpected person you encounter. Then report to [Dayna] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Jelic, if that's cake, it's awful. I mean, I can't eat it. Take it back. I'm sick of it. I already eat it every single day….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jelic brought me this time, instead of cake.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Oh, it's you, %s. Jelic must have brought you here about that matter.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: It's about Narsha.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Yes, the suspicious person who was after her recently.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I hear he's come and gone three times already.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Security in the heart of Guild Union Esnil is tight, to keep suspicious people out.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: With President Dayna here, even people working for the Silvaria Empire's parliament or imperial palace need permission to enter.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: There are also barriers the guild mages have put up, some more noticeable than others….

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: To slip past those barriers, the Guild Union guards, and so many skilled people….

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: He clearly isn't an ordinary person.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: All we've learned so far is that he has ears like Narsha's, seems to be a shaman, and appeared in the El Anor Plains.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: The guards and members of Moonlight are searching the plains, but we have no other useful leads.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: So, since you're here, we'd like your help for a little while. Narsha's magic golem came from the Magic Bureau….

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: If this is connected to people or incidents involving the bureau, it could become a serious problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A serious problem…. If enough of those pile up, Iris could be in danger, couldn't she?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That reminds me of what Medea said. If I follow where fate leads me, I may find my answer at the end….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That's true. Somehow, I've ended up here….)

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: What's got you thinking so hard?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing. What would you like me to do?

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: We'll search the eastern and southern plains and the mountains. Could you look for anything unusual in the western plains?

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: You might be able to see something we can't, %s.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: This is an official guild request, so you'll be properly paid. For now, take some of my cake….

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Jelic, put that away. Don't give it to %s. Leave it here.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: You're so cold, Raclette.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where does all that cake come from?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Hehe. An elf's pocket is a magic pocket.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: If you get Jelic started on desserts or cake, we'll never hear the end of it. Please begin your search.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's quite a way to the western plains, so I'll head out first.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Just have a look around and come back. Jelic, let's go too.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Jelic, stop. Don't pack cake to eat on the way. No pudding either.
(In a quiet part of the western El Anor Plains where the kobold royal guards once stood, %s comes to a halt.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't know there was a road here. Does it lead to Knossos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, what's this feeling…?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Someone's watching me from behind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (They don't seem to intend to attack, but I still need to be careful.)
Passage through this area is forbidden by decree of the Silvaria Empire…. You are….
(A familiar figure emerges from farther down the road and blocks the way.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent? What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I was about to ask you the same thing. What brings you here, %s? You may be interfering with official duties….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well…. Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That strange feeling again?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What I felt just now wasn't Argent. It was definitely like the presence of that woman who appeared in Medea's place.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Did you sense something here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It must be my imagination. Someone at the Guild Union is in a difficult situation, so I was looking for something.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: A Guild Union matter? You may tell me about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… all right. Well….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly tell Argent that I'm searching for traces of a suspicious person.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: So that happened to a girl named Narsha?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Someone who looks like a shaman, with animal ears….

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I will ask the rangers stationed along Knossos Road. Please wait a moment.
(As soon as he finishes speaking, Argent heads down the road.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Argent and the rangers are here, does that mean this is imperial territory? They still seem busy enough with the kobolds on the plains….

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Hmm….
(A little later, Argent returns with a doubtful expression.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: There is someone who matches your description, %s. However, I am told he has been with the rangers almost constantly for the entire month and hasn't come outside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm….

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: The empire has kept watch over Knossos for a long time. It occupied the area on the pretext of defending against the beastfolk. Now, even the beastfolk have abandoned it.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: As a result, beastfolk must obtain permission from a Silvaria Empire ranger outpost before traveling elsewhere.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I am not in charge here, so that is all I can tell you. Even you do not currently have permission to enter, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need the empire's permission, then?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Correct. For now, please return and tell them what I've told you. I will put in a request for your permission to enter.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. But what brings you here, Argent?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Parliamentary business. I'm sorry, but I cannot discuss it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's all right. I'll be going, then. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Until we meet again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Since Knossos is connected to the empire, I should tell Dayna, shouldn't I?)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Is something about to happen?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: (I should investigate the people at the Magic Bureau….)

steps.name: The Path to Answers (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Chloris] in 「Magic Academy Main Building」 and obtain the <Academy Festival Records>. Then report to [Medea] in 「Kali」.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s, you're back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna, you're here.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes. I stayed here to wait for you, %s.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Raclette and Jelic returned from their patrol, but they didn't find much.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Well? How did it go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't find any trace of the suspicious person, but Argent helped me.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Argent was there? Never mind, go on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent asked at the ranger outpost, but they said none of the beastfolk had come outside.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That's right. The beastfolk there always need permission from the outpost to travel, even when they're going into their own territory….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But I sensed something strange.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: What was it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I felt as though someone was watching me there.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Hmm…. "Someone" doesn't tell me much. Can you compare it to a situation or a person you've encountered before, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it was that woman….

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The witch?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But it was different too. To be precise, it felt like her, but it wasn't her. It seemed to be someone else….

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm sorry. I don't have much information about the witch. I've never been to the beastfolk empire's territory. I've had no reason to go. I haven't, at least….

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Still, I'll look into it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Dayna.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: And there's something I want to ask you, %s. Your visit to Narsha wasn't a coincidence, was it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No…. Here's what happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Since Dayna has noticed my search for answers, I tell her about Medea.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Medea, the Champion…. I was curious about what sort of person she was. To think she bears such a painful fate….

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The witch….

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: My sister and I also need to resolve that problem, so I think it will tie into her decision.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: And Eastland's other side has been growing enormously lately. It must be the work of the one waiting for that day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss….

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you for looking out for Narsha. I'll investigate that suspicious person further.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're handling it, I'm sure things will be all right. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything you'd like me to pass along?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Jade once mentioned seeing a book at Xerenis Magic Academy that recorded the early days of its festival. If you find it and give it to her, she may learn something.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The festival is named Daphne, after all….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You might be right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll take it to her. See you later, Dayna.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes, see you later.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You've returned. I've been waiting for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You must be tired. Some tea…. No, I'll stop serving that tea now. I'll bring you something else.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you for willingly setting out on this journey for me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now, would you tell me what happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I'll start with my visit to Noel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Medea about meeting Noel, Titi, Narin, and Narsha, and about following the suspicious man's trail.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You've been through a great deal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And I have something for you. This book.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What is it about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna told me about a book on the festival held at Xerenis Magic Academy, so I found it and brought it here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe it's because the book contains magic, but I couldn't make out the writing. You might be able to read it, Medea.
(Medea takes the book and begins to examine it slowly.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: An academy festival…. Is that a festival held at a place where children are taught?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, an event at a school or somewhere like that.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: How enviable. Freios has places where children can learn and enjoy themselves….

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The people of Eastland, including our Kali tribe, have had few such experiences.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: For people who faced life and death amid long years of conflict and battle, survival came first.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Forgive me. There was no need to say that. Would you wait while I examine the book a little more? I don't know whether my magic will let me read its contents….

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thankfully, I can read it with my magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Take your time. I'll drink the tea you brought me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The festival is named "Daphne"…? Her name….

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The festival began to coincide with a visit from the emperor, and it received its name as it became an established event.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That was exactly when our tribe was pursued by the Order and driven from the land we loved.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: …An academy festival, an occasion for gifted students of magic to show their skills….

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It says there were many accidents in the early days. Among them were cases of students being killed or going missing because of a certain golem.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And the place where they went missing was Knossos Road….

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now I understand. Why I felt that way….
(Medea approaches the flower bed behind her and stares at a plant growing there. A moment later, a small flame rises from its roots and burns away every leaf and stem.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will never serve that tea again. That was the last plant….

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And I may be going there myself before long.
